entities.summary: Richard Cobden was a British Radical and Liberal politician, manufacturer, and a campaigner for free trade and peace. He was associated with the Anti–Corn Law League and the Cobden–Chevalier Treaty. Richard Cobden was a performers & entertainers from Heyshott (1804-06-03, Heyshott–1865-04-02). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to economic history and geopolitics.
